caption: The drawing depicts a long, ornate dress with no wearer visible. The dress is primarily a soft pink color, adorned with small floral patterns in red and green scattered across the bodice, sleeves, and outer skirt. The design features a fitted bodice with a deep, rounded neckline, which is trimmed with a white decorative edge. The sleeves are three-quarter length and end in wide, ruffled cuffs with similar white edging and floral accents. The skirt has two distinct layers: the outer layer is pink with vertical white stripes and small floral motifs, and it is gathered and parted to reveal a cream or pale yellow underskirt. The underskirt has a subtle diamond or lattice pattern and ends in a lighter, more translucent cream hem decorated with white flowers. The background is a plain, beige or light tan color without any additional objects or details.
title: Dress
